sites.name: GitHub
sites.notes: Reliable: 404 for unknown users.

sites.name: GitLab
sites.notes: Public users API returns an empty array for unknown names.

sites.name: Reddit
sites.notes: Often rate-limits anonymous clients (403/429).

sites.name: X / Twitter
sites.notes: Requires login for profile pages; cannot be checked anonymously. Open the link to verify.

sites.name: Instagram
sites.notes: Serves a login wall to anonymous clients. Open the link to verify.

sites.name: Facebook
sites.notes: Blocks anonymous checks. Open the link to verify.

sites.name: Threads
sites.notes: Same backend as Instagram; blocks anonymous checks.

sites.name: TikTok
sites.notes: Returns HTTP 200 for missing accounts and bot-checks anonymous clients. Open the link to verify.

sites.name: LinkedIn
sites.notes: Answers anonymous clients with HTTP 999. Profile slugs often differ from handles.

sites.name: Snapchat
sites.notes: Public add page returns 404 for unknown names.

sites.name: Telegram
sites.notes: Existing users, channels and bots render a title block. Hidden usernames can look absent.

sites.name: YouTube
sites.notes: Handle URL returns 404 for unknown handles. EU consent redirects show as unknown.

sites.name: Twitch
sites.notes: Single-page app; only a matching og:title counts as found.

sites.name: Kick
sites.notes: Cloudflare frequently blocks anonymous checks.

sites.name: Pastebin
sites.notes: Scammers use pastes for fake 'guides' and payment instructions.

sites.name: Pinterest
sites.notes: Only a profile JSON blob naming the user counts as found; otherwise unknown.

sites.name: Mastodon (mastodon.social)
sites.notes: Only checks the mastodon.social instance.

sites.name: Bluesky
sites.notes: Public AppView API; only checks the default .bsky.social domain.

sites.name: Weibo
sites.notes: Requires login; profiles are keyed by numeric IDs.

sites.name: Quora
sites.notes: Slugs usually look like First-Last; often bot-checks anonymous clients.

sites.name: Keybase
sites.notes: Keybase proofs can link other accounts cryptographically.

sites.name: Linktree
sites.notes: Link-in-bio pages often list the actor's other accounts and payment links.

sites.name: Cash App
sites.notes: $cashtag page. Payment handles in scam DMs are strong identifiers.

sites.name: Venmo
sites.notes: Frequently bot-checks anonymous clients.

sites.name: PayPal.me
sites.notes: Serves the same page for unknown names. Open the link to verify.

sites.name: Ko-fi
sites.notes: Unknown names redirect away from the profile URL.

sites.name: OnlyFans
sites.notes: Single-page app that returns 200 for everything. Often used in sextortion and romance-scam funnels.

sites.name: Fiverr
sites.notes: Usually bot-checks anonymous clients.

sites.name: Upwork
sites.notes: Profiles use opaque IDs, not usernames. The link runs a search.

sites.name: Etsy
sites.notes: Checks shop names. Often bot-checks anonymous clients.

sites.name: eBay
sites.errorMsg: The User ID you entered was not found
sites.notes: Often bot-checks anonymous clients.

sites.name: OpenSea
sites.notes: NFT marketplace profile. Cloudflare frequently blocks anonymous checks.

sites.name: TradingView
sites.notes: Fake trading 'mentors' often keep a TradingView profile for credibility.

sites.name: Steam
sites.errorMsg: The specified profile could not be found
sites.notes: Checks custom profile URLs only.

sites.name: Flickr
sites.notes: Stolen profile photos are often traced back to Flickr.

sites.name: npm
sites.notes: Searches package maintainers, so it only finds users who publish packages. No match is reported as unknown.

sites.name: PyPI
sites.notes: PyPI serves a JavaScript client challenge to scripts; such answers are reported as blocked.
